  tag: "latest"

global:
  imageRegistry: ""
  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# Backend services common configuration
backend:
  replicaCount: 1
  imageTag: latest
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 500m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
  env: {}
# List of backend services
backendServices:
  - name: auth-service
    port: 80
  - name: user-service
    port: 80
  - name: profile-service
    port: 80
  - name: discovery-service
    port: 80
  - name: booking-service

  - name: analytics-service
    port: 80
  - name: api-gateway
    port: 80

# Frontend configuration

  imageTag: latest
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 500m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m

# Infrastructure services
postgres:
  imageTag: "15-3.4"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 500m

    limits:

    requests:

  # PostgreSQL credentials
  POSTGRES_USER: YWRtaW4=           # Default: "admin" - Base64 encoded
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: c2VjcmV0      # secret

  RABBITMQ_PASSWORD: c2VjcmV0      # secret

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "cue.fullname" . }}-postgres

    helm.sh/chart: {{ .Chart.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}

  replicas: {{ .Values.postgres.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:

  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        helm.sh/chart: {{ .Chart.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}

        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
    spec:

        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:{{ .Values.postgres.imageTag }}

    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
